quarterly_data.signal: SUMCO's notice: FORMOSA SUMCO TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION (FST) was reclassified from a consolidated subsidiary to an equity-method affiliate after the SUMCO group completed the sale of part of its FST shares on the Taiwan securities market on August 20, 2026, cutting its voting rights ratio in FST from 43.2% to 38.0%; FST will be accounted for as an equity-method affiliate with September 30, 2026 (the end of Q3 of the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026) as the deemed reclassification date. SUMCO says FST remains an important production and sales base for the group and that the impact on its 2026 consolidated results is under review.
